matching_rule: Exactly one specification per planned source-document ID; no extras.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Restricted cover/control, persons/non-operative charges, offence and clinical/procedural chronologies, temporal-question matrix, expert/application map, route alternatives, deadlines and unresolved decisions; neutral orientation.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 14-20 pages; 300-500 words/narrative page and 10-22 sourced events/table page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible PDF; searchable text, stable links and repeated headers; not scanned.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Fluctuating state, unknown periods and later report versions retained; dates may be ranges when source is imprecise.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Medical/family/contact detail minimised by audience; client version accessible but not diagnostic/deterministic; court/CPS only authorised data.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied clinical records, generic psychiatry/law, repeated chronology, decorative route diagrams or blank padding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Fire incident/witness/scene suite with statements, call/CCTV register, scene photographs/plans, exhibit continuity, fire-origin/cause examination, laboratory results and expert limitations; establishes act/damage evidence independently.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 30-42 pages; statements/report 250-500 words/page, exhibit tables 8-20 rows/page and 1-4 necessary images/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed signed scans, native media external, born-digital fire report and colour evidential photographs with scale/source labels.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Fire damage, obscured scene, uncertain origin zone, lab limitation and expert addendum legitimate and explicit; no artificial degradation.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Premises security, witness contact and irrelevant images restricted; authorised evidence only in client/court outputs.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated scene photos, generic fire science, decorative plans, duplicate continuity forms or invented laboratory data.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: act evidence not merged with mental state

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Custody and interview section with rights, detention reviews, healthcare contacts, medication/observation logs, reasonable adjustments, audio index/transcript and contemporaneous behaviour statements; records events without retrospective diagnosis.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 22-32 pages; forms retain authentic whitespace, logs 10-24 events/page and transcript 35-70 turns/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Scanned custody/healthcare forms and born-digital logs/transcript; native audio external; handwriting legible or marked unreadable.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Behaviour fluctuation, missed medication source, clock conflict, inaudible passage and corrected log allowed with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Healthcare and legal-advice details restricted; privileged consultation excluded; client/court/CPS see only relevant authorised records.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated rights text, invented observations, generic symptom checklists, duplicate transcript or blank forms.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Focused longitudinal GP/hospital record set with scoped request, provider index, contemporaneous entries/results/medication, gaps, provenance/viewing log, redaction/minimisation and disclosure state; source history for expert review.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 25-35 pages; clinical entries 180-420 words/page, medication/results tables 8-20 rows/page and forms retain legitimate whitespace.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed provider scans and born-digital focused extracts; original abbreviations/layout preserved; OCR is aid only and source scan remains authoritative.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Abbreviations, correction, missing interval, duplicated provider entry and later letter allowed with explicit provenance.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Special-category data; unrelated physical/family/third-party history removed; full records restricted; client/court receive proportionate material.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No wholesale record dump, repeated medication lists, generic condition material, fabricated history or blank clinical forms.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Defence psychiatric instruction-state register, served expert report, examination details, materials, functional fitness questions, event-state questions, assumptions, limitations and addendum; individual opinion only.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 22-32 pages; 300-550 substantive words/page and functional-question tables 6-14 rows/page; signature/declaration pages may be sparse.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital signed report; source records referenced, not bulk duplicated; scanned signature acceptable; no hidden clinical appendix.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Provisional view, inability to answer one question, changed opinion after records and addendum retained with earlier version.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Instructions/attendance notes privileged; served report separately controlled; irrelevant medical/family details minimised; client gets accessible explanation.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No generic diagnostic textbook, repeated CV, copied clinical records, invented tests, boilerplate conclusions or duplicate histories.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: expert does not decide legal fitness/defence

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Prosecution psychiatric report and addendum plus expert joint statement recording dated issue-by-issue agreements/disagreements; preserves latest individual positions outside joint scope.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 25-36 pages; reports 300-550 words/page and joint table 5-12 substantive issues/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital signed reports/joint statement; appendices selective and source-linked; signatures/declarations visible.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Opinion change, unresolved disagreement, late record and joint statement limited to selected issues are legitimate with dates.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Medical detail purpose-limited; served parties/court authorised access; internal instructions protected; client gets appropriate explanation.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No duplicated defence report, repeated qualifications, generic psychiatry, copied records, artificial issue rows or forced consensus.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: joint statement authoritative only for recorded issues/date

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Communication/effective-participation suite: referral, intermediary/communication assessment, functional profile, recommendations, application/response, participation plan, ground-rules agenda/direction and implementation log.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-20 pages; assessments 250-450 words/page, recommendation/action tables 6-15 rows/page and directions 150-350 words/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible assessment/forms/direction; signed scan only where source-authentic; client-facing participation plan uses readable layout.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Provisional recommendation, reassessment, partial direction and implementation problem retained with dated history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Health/communication details minimised; full assessment role-limited; client receives own participation plan; open version excludes unnecessary diagnosis.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No generic disability prose, repeated recommendations, invented scores, duplicate blank forms or decorative easy-read pages.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: accessible typography without loss of state

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Procedural bundle for report/remand/treatment proposals, fitness evidence/application/hearing/ruling, alternative act/omission fact-finding plan, insanity/automatism evidential route, special-verdict/disposal possibilities and judicial orders; no outcome predetermined.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 28-40 pages; applications/evidence 250-500 words/page, orders 150-350 words/page and procedural tables 6-16 events/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital application/order-style records; signed/sealed scans where realistic; confidential clinical supplements separate from open record.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Adjournment for report, revised proposal, partial ruling and later clinical update legitimate with full chronology.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Clinical reports/supplements and placement detail restricted; client/open versions disclose necessary procedure only; court order governs use.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied statutory text, duplicate blank applications, invented findings/orders, generic hospital material or artificial alternative-route pages.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Disclosure schedules/decisions, privilege log, counsel extracts, report/service matrix, hearing and CTL/deadline tracker, evidence-preservation and alternative-route/resumption-readiness checklist; records process without selecting route.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 20-30 pages; schedules 10-24 rows/page, counsel extracts 300-500 words/page and deadline/action tables 8-18 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital schedules/trackers with stable row IDs; signed/scanned advice or orders only where authorised; no hidden columns.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Late clinical record, superseded schedule, adjourned hearing, extension application and unresolved route action retained with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Privilege and medical sensitivity role-limited; defence advice has zero CPS/court leakage; client receives appropriate deadline/hearing explanation.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No boilerplate rows, repeated advice, generic deadline charts, duplicate report lists, empty action rows or simulated resumption events.
